verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.warp.co that indexes the API docs, and doc pages are served as agent-friendly Markdown (.md URLs, with llms.txt entries describing endpoints). The docs also explicitly mention giving documentation-aware AI tools access to the Warp API definition. Missing for 10: no first-party guidance on pointing agents at llms.txt, and no evidence of an llms-full.txt or similar full-content bundle.
